description.value: Neptune Seafood Restaurant is a long-established Cantonese and seafood dining destination founded in 1997 by the Neptune Restaurant Group, with a reputation for abalone specialties and gourmet dim sum across its Greater Vancouver locations. It holds membership in the Commanderie des Cordons Bleu de France and has been recognized as one of Vancouver's Top Ten Chinese Restaurants. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond can stop for a sit-down dim sum lunch or dinner, or order takeout through several delivery and pickup platforms.
